Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a two-vehicle collision in Pearland, Texas, at an intersection with a signalized left turn. Driver 1
stated that while turning left across the path of oncoming traffic, the front of the vehicle was struck by Driver 2's
vehicle. Driver 1's insurance card matched the name on the registration, and the vehicle's registered owner was
confirmed as Driver 1. Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle, and both Passenger
and a bystander confirmed this at the scene. Driver 2 gave a statement consistent with Dirver 1's account of the
sequence of events. Two independent witnesses and photographs taken at the scene support the description of how
the collision occurred. The damage to the front driver's side of Driver 1's vehicle and the rear of Driver 2's vehicle is
consistent with the angle and force of the impact. Officers found no prior damage to either vehicle. Driver 1 reported
neck pain and stiffness and was evaluated at the scene. The reported symptoms are consistent with the mechanism
of the collision. Driver 1 was transported for further evaluation.
